name: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd
title: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd - 544283 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 59% to INR2,507 crore with ~90% EBITDA margin, but growth is now BESS merchant arbitrage (2.3 GWh, ~INR2.2 crore/day) and capex timing is being deferred around transmission delays; no numeric prior guidance was supplied to test against.

utilisation.quote: Our CUF stood at 26.9% in Q4.

capex.peers_comment: Industry-wide: developers defer module procurement when substations lag; 'that is how the industry has been doing'.
capex.quote: We can defer our sizable capex of modules because modules are available just in time

triggers.label: Solar capex deferred until CTU ready
triggers.quote: we are deferring the solar part of capex. We are not installing the modules.

triggers.label: BESS realisation INR2.2 crore/day
triggers.quote: it is delivering net realization value of approximately INR2.2 crores per day

triggers.label: Target 1.5 GW generation and ~10 GWh BESS in FY27
triggers.quote: we are targeting 1.5 gigawatts of projects in this financial year, right, and around 10 gigawatt hour of battery

triggers.label: Solar least-sold tender segment
triggers.quote: plain solar is the hardest to sell

guidance.quote: we are targeting 1.5 gigawatts of projects in this financial year
10 gigawatt hour of battery during the next of the calendar year
these will be commissioned by FY 28

red_flags.label: Battery-linked merchant revenue at ~75-80% margin assumed, arbitrage duration uncertain
red_flags.quote: This is anybody's guess in terms of that.

red_flags.label: Pre-COD plant energised and sold via battery, not grid-connected
red_flags.quote: we are installing the solar and we are installing the entire power generation also, but we are not connecting it.

red_flags.label: CFO change during the period
red_flags.quote: He has decided to pursue career opportunities outside of ACME.

evasions.quote: This is anybody's guess in terms of that.
we don't have that number in this year
So, 87% is our EBITDA for this year, right.
